title: Presentation file (.pres.toml), as the JSON value of its TOML
description: A presentation of a strict monoidal supercategory: colours, generators (possibly schemas over colour variables), parameters, relation schemas, and representations. Terms inside are in the text term format (spec/text-term.md).

colours.description: Fixed colours, or "cartan": one colour per simple root of the context's Cartan datum.

objects.description: "weight": a term without an idempotent ranges over all sequences of the context's weight; "explicit": only objects written in the term.

generator_order.description: The order of the generators (TOML tables are unordered).

bubbles.description: Bubble families of a 2-category: written NAME_{c,m} in terms, a closed diagram in the region it sits in. For m with index(m) >= 0 the bubble is its word; below that it is a fake bubble, determined by the infinite Grassmannian relation with its partner family.

lean.description: The Lean counterpart, for exporting rewrite chains: where the diagrams live and which lemma proves each relation. Templates write {a} for a colour variable, {a!=b} for a proof that two colours differ, and {simp} for a side condition simp proves.

module.description: Modules to import, separated by spaces.

derived.description: skm-cl: the layers of each generator the Lean library defines rather than takes, as cases tried in order. A case applies when its condition holds at the region right of the generator; each layer is [left strands, shape, right strands] with an optional repeat count, in the generator's colour variables and h(a).

when.description: A condition on h(a), p(a); empty for every region.

sign.description: An integer expression; the expansion carries (-1) to this power.

negate.description: The expansion carries a further minus sign.

lemma.description: The lemma, applied at the weight ν. Placeholders: {a} a colour variable, {a!=b} a proof that two colours differ, {m} an integer variable, {ip a} the hypothesis ip RD a ν = n of a weight-dependent relation, {simp} a simp call with the colour inequalities.

facts.description: Cartan data the lemma depends on: 'dot {a} {b}', 'dot≠0 {a} {b}', or 'dij {a} {b}' (kl3-dg); 'd {a} {b}', 'dn {a} {b}', 't {a} {b}' (t_ab = 1), or 's {a} {b}' (s_ab = 0) (skm-cl).

pattern_layering.description: How the lemma lays out its left-hand side; the exported proof reaches it from the calculator's layout by interchange moves.

proof.description: How the lemma proves the relation as the calculator states it: 'rw' (rewrite with it, then normalize sums), 'exact' (it is the statement up to unfolding), or 'tactic' (the lemma field is a tactic script, steps separated by '; ').

intExpr.description: An integer, or an expression in the colour variables: (a,b) the symmetric form, a_ab a Cartan entry, d_a a symmetrizer, p(a) a parity, h(a) the pairing of h_a with the weight of the region right of the generator (in a 2-category), with + - and juxtaposed products.

pattern.description: Space-separated colours or colour variables, a trailing * for a downward strand.

colours.description: Space-separated colour variables of the schema.

written.description: The name the generator is written with in terms, when several generators share it (for example a dot on an upward and on a downward strand). The source decides which one is meant; a generator with an empty source takes its colour explicitly, as cup_{1,a*}.

default.description: A built-in default (klq2) or a polynomial in vars.

when.description: A side condition: a = b, a != b, and, or, not, comparisons of integer expressions.

ints.description: Integer variables of the schema, each with an inclusive range whose ends are integer expressions (they may use h(a), the weight of the relation's rightmost region). An empty range gives no instance.

target.description: For kind translation: the shipped presentation whose first representation decides equality.

images.description: For kind translation: each generator's image in the target, a term in the generator's colour variables. Every generator of the target's normal forms must be the image of exactly one generator.

even_only.description: The representation holds only when every colour is even; in a context with an odd colour it does not apply.

roles.description: Generator names by role: dot and crossing for klr-polynomial, quiver-hecke-basis, and the nil-Coxeter kinds; x, xd, psi, psid, cup_ef, cup_fe, cap_ef, cap_fe for kl-basis, and also lcross for skm-basis.

even_certificate.description: The certificate in a context whose colours are all even, when it is stronger there than certificate (a theorem for even data, a conjecture in general).

word.description: The bubble for label m, a term with no source or target in which the integer variable m may appear.

index.description: Half the degree divided by d_a, as an expression in m and h(a); the bubble is real where it is >= 0. The fake bubbles of index k are the coefficients of the inverse of the partner family's generating series.

partner.description: The family that enters the infinite Grassmannian relation with this one.
